Constitution
of the Council for Extension. Research
and DeveloQment. The Council for Extension, Research and Development
in Agriculture
and Fisheries,
hereinafter
referred to as CERDAF, is
hereby constituted.
The CERDAF shall be composed of the following:
Vice Chairman
~
Secretary of Agriculture
Secretary of Science and Technology
Secretary of Environment and Natural
Secretary of Agrarian Reform
Director-General of the National
Economic and Development Authority
Chairman of the Commission on Higher
Execu tive Director of the Philippine
Council for Agriculture, Forestry, Natural
Resources Research and Development

1.
Executive Director of the Philippine
Council for Aquatic and Marine Research
and Development
President of the League of Provinces
President of the League of Municipalities
National Chairman of the Fisheries and
Aquatic Resources Management Council
President of the Chamber of Fisheries
and Aquatic Resources of the Philippines
Two representatives from the academe
One representatives each from a
national farmers organization and
a national fisherfolk organization
One representative each from the
crops, livestock and processing sectors
Three research, development and
extension experts
The academe shall be represented by heads of national universities
specializing in agriculture and fishery.
The representatives
from the academe, farmers and fisherfolk
organization,
crops, livestock and processing sectors, and the R & D
experts shall be appointed
by the Chairman as recommended by the
other members of CERDAF.

Functions.
The CERDAF shall have the following
Enhance coordination of government institutions
involved in
agriculture
and fisheries R & D and extension, and pursue
the integration
of R & D and extension
efforts of the
government;
Encourage the participation
of the private
sector in the
development of a national R & D and extension agenda;
oversee the
implementation
comprehensive and responsive R & D and extension program
for agriculture and fisheries to enhance and make full use of
Development
Agriculture
and Fisheries
(NARDSAF) and the National
Extension System for Agriculture and Fisheries (NESAF), our
on R & D and extension,
respectively,
established under RA 8435;

Set policies that will promote agriculture and fishery R & D
Philippine
international
institutions
involved in R &D;
Approve the allocation
from local and foreign
sources for R & D and extension programs, projects and
activities;
Adopt policies to strengthen the institutional
efficiency of the
national R & D and extension system, including the setting
monitoring
evaluation
effectiveness and efficiency of its various components;
Review and approve national R & D and extension plans and
programs developed by the NARDSAF and NESAF;
Create committees, technical working groups and commodity
.-
Formulate implementing rules and regulations as may be
necessary to carry out its functions.

Secretariat.
The Bureau of Agricultural
Research and
the Agricultural
(BAR) and the Agricultural
Training Institute
serve as the secretariat of the CERDAF.
The BAR shall provide technical and administrative
support for R
& D activities of the CERDAF, while the AT! shall provide assistance on
extension and training matters. The specific functions
of the BAR and
the AT! shall be in accordance
the implementing
regulations of RA 8435.
To upgrade the capabilities
of BAR and AT! staff, they shallundertake
the following:
Develop a staffing
based on the science and
technology career system for its technical
personnel to be
approved by CERDAF, and thus entitle its staff to a system
of benefits equivalent to those enjoyed by the science and
of the Department
of Science and
Technology;
facilitate
accomplishment
objectives; and

Draw from state colleges and universities,
institutes
centers, scientists, professors, technical experts, for detail or
secondment at BAR and AT! to accelerate the upgrading of
their technical competence; and
Provide detailed staff an honoraria
system based on the
Magna Carta for Science and Technical Personnel or at least
75 percent of their basic pay at their mother units for those
detailed on a full-time basis.
RelationshiD of CERDAF with Other Multi-Sectoral
Councils and Other Agencies under the DeDartment of Ag!jculture.
CERDAF shall collaborate with the Philippine
Council for Agriculture,
Forestry, Natural Resources Research and Development (PCARRD) , the
Philippine
Council for Aquatic and Marine Research and Development
(PCAMRD) and other concerned agencies and institutions
in the following
Formulation of R & D agenda and programs;
Screening of proposals and monitoring
of ongoing R & D
projects in the country;
Development of methodologies and systems for effective R &
in agriculture
and fisheries,
emphasizing the
quality and intensity of participation
of farmers, fishers and
the private sector in setting the R & D and extension agenda
and the allocation of resources;
Development of output-oriented
performance standards for
staff, institutions
and programs in agriculture
and fisheries
Establishment
of an efficient and effective computerized
system of monitoring
and evaluation of R & D staff and
institutions,
including database required for the assessment
of research excellence, performance and capacity;
~
Development and administration
of a career development
program and a unified merit promotion system for scientific
and technical personnel in agriculture and fishery R & D and

Development and administration
of an incentive system to
support high quality scientific journals
in agriculture
Development of a human resource maintenance system for
providing incentives and benefits to technical and scientific
personnel in agriculture
and fishery to ensure that
agriculture and fishery institutions
gain and maintain a
competitive edge in attracting and maintaining their staff;
Provision of technical
assistance
in the improvement
institutional
and staff capabilities; and
Formulation of guidelines in planning and implementation
agriculture and fisheries research.

Funding.
The funds required to operate CERDAF
shall be drawn from the appropriations
of the Department of Agriculture.

Re2ealing Clause. All other laws, decrees, orders,
rules and regulations or parts thereof inconsistent with the provisions of
this Executive Order are hereby repealed or amended accordingly.
